{"metadata":{"description":"ACP server for DeepSeek Harness — bridges Zed and other IDEs to dsh agents","id":"gh:1334774353","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-acp","slug":"cnctem/dsh-acp","topics":["acp","coding-agent","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","zed"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"ACP server for DeepSeek Harness — bridges Zed and other IDEs to dsh agents"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"> [!WARNING]
> **This project is no longer maintained.** We recommend using openma-ai/deepseek-harne"},{"id":"p2s2","text":"**This project is no longer maintained.** We recommend using openma-ai/deepseek-harness-acp instead."},{"id":"p3s1","text":"# dsh-acp"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> 简体中文 · 技术文档 / Technical notes"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"An **Agent Client Protocol (ACP)** server for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) that lets Zed and other edito"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"rs drive dsh agents over **JSON-RPC 2.0 stdio**."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The shipped dsh `acp` profile is intentionally automation-only. This bundle is a drop-in replacement"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" for its bridge: it keeps the standard automation surface (sessions, MCP, model selection, permissio"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ns) and adds the editor experience Zed needs on top."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Introduction"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"`dsh-acp` mounts one ACP server on dsh stdin/stdout. Zed launches `dsh --profile acp`; the plugin tr"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"anslates `session/*` requests into dsh Agent lifecycles. Installing this bundle requires no Zed conf"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"iguration change because it disables both the shipped `acp` bridge and startup row, then mounts this"},{"id":"p8s4","text":" implementation and the same stdin-lifetime provider under unique ids."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **Standard ACP lifecycle** — `initialize`, `session/new`, `session/list`, `session/resume`, `sessi"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"on/close`, `session/prompt`, and `session/cancel`
- **Lazy empty sessions** — `session/new` is provi"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"sional: the Agent, preset/MCP mounts, and durable session begin only after the first accepted prompt"},{"id":"p10s4","text":", while the slash-command catalog is already advertised so `/` works on the first message
- **Editor"},{"id":"p10s5","text":" history extensions** — `session/load` replays durable history; `session/delete` closes a live sessi"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"on and removes its persisted artifact when the backend exposes deletion
- **Token & thinking streami"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"ng** — `agent/assistant-stream` frames projected as `agent_message_chunk` / `agent_thought_chunk`
- "},{"id":"p10s8","text":"**Tool cards** — `tool_call` / `tool_call_update` with kind, file location and line
- **Structured d"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"iffs** — native tool hunks plus before/after file snapshots
- **Bash terminal** — command output ren"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"dered as terminal content with exit code
- **Context-usage ring** — `usage_update` (used / size)
- *"},{"id":"p10s11","text":"*Todo list** — dsh `todo_write` snapshots rendered as the stable ACP `plan` update
- **Goal in the t"},{"id":"p10s12","text":"ask list** — the current goal leads the ACP `plan` (`Goal: … · Round n/N · phase`), and automatic co"},{"id":"p10s13","text":"ntinuation rounds advance that row while the checklist survives each round
- **Images** — ACP image "},{"id":"p10s14","text":"prompts admitted through the durable attachment seam; capability advertised when any selectable rout"},{"id":"p10s15","text":"e supports images, and the exact pinned route is validated per prompt
- **Slash commands** — dsh com"},{"id":"p10s16","text":"mands advertised through `available_commands_update`; recognized commands stay in the command plane "},{"id":"p10s17","text":"and receive typed image attachments
- **Ask the user** — dsh's scoped `user-questions/request` water"},{"id":"p10s18","text":"fall answered through stable ACP form `elicitation/create`
- **Agent presets** — `standard`, `ptc`, "},{"id":"p10s19","text":"`minimal`, and `cordis` (creation mode) are declared by this bundle and selected for the whole proce"},{"id":"p10s20","text":"ss through `DSH_ACP_PRESET`
- **MCP servers** — client-supplied stdio and Streamable HTTP MCP server"},{"id":"p10s21","text":"s are validated and mounted into the Agent scope
- **Turn-pinned model selection** — model and reaso"},{"id":"p10s22","text":"ning changes affect later prompts; an in-flight turn keeps the route with which it was admitted"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Prerequisites: Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, `dsh@0.2.1-rc.2`, and `pnpm`."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"From source:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Existing installs upgrade with the same command; the effective `acp` profile now contains the custom"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" bridge instead of the automation-only bridge."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### Use as a package"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"`@cnctem/dsh-acp` is also importable from a Node/Cordis host. It is a plugin, not a standalone execu"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"table: the host must compose the dsh services required by its dependencies and peers before mounting"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"e: the host must compose the dsh services required by its dependencies and peers before mounting it."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- `DSH_ACP_PROVIDER` / `DSH_ACP_MODEL` override the default provider/model. Unset values follow dsh "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"`agent-default-model`.
- `DSH_ACP_PRESET` selects the process-level agent composition. Unset or empt"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"y uses the registry default, `standard`.
- Built-in presets:
- `standard` — coding tools, plan mode,"},{"id":"p21s4","text":" todos, web, subagents.
- `ptc` — standard tools plus presentation/code-runtime behavior.
- `minimal"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"` — a persistent shell and minimal persona.
- `cordis` — creation mode with plugin-manager and Cordi"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"s inspection tools plus the bundled authoring skills.
- The old `$DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/<id>` dire"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"ctory scan is no longer supported. Presets are ordinary `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` declarations"},{"id":"p21s8","text":" in this bundle and can be overridden by a later profile patch.
- API keys reuse dsh credentials (`$"},{"id":"p21s9","text":"DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`, account auth, or `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`)."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Integration"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Add to Zed's `settings.json` if the entry does not already exist:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"To expose multiple deployments, use separate Zed entries with different `DSH_ACP_PRESET` values. Eac"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"h dsh process has one process-level preset selection."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Source lives in `src/`; TypeScript generates committed ESM, declarations, and source maps in `lib/`."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"`pnpm run test:profile` requires a working `dsh` executable.
